drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Counsel,

Please find attached Defendant's Response to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production. We have responded with appropriate objections and will produce all non-privileged, responsive documents. We reserve the right to supplement this response as discovery proceeds.

We look forward to resolving discovery efficiently and cooperatively.

Best regards,

Counsel for Defendant

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected by the attorney-client privilege, work product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection.
edits.name: Refine general objections for clarity and legal accuracy

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce all responsive, non-privileged documents in its possession, custody, or control as they are reasonably located and identified.
edits.name: Clarify production commitment

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on grounds of privilege or protection will be identified in a privilege log produced concurrently with or prior to the production of documents.
edits.name: Detail privilege log timing

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION OF RIGHTS. Defendant expressly reserves the right to supplement, amend, or supplement this response if additional information becomes available or circumstances change.
edits.name: Formalize reservation of rights
